item.title: GMKTec NucBox EVO-X1 Pro mini PC review
item.description: GMKTec NucBox EVO-X1 Pro is a tiny NUC PC built around the AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 470 or HX370, perfect for those who need a high-performance desktop system.

item.title: Will AI expose the rickety infrastructure of the internet?
item.description: The moment you realize the internet is "held together by glue and dreams."

item.title: How much?? Chinese startup unveils copper-colored AI Max+ PRO 495 workstation with 192GB RAM selling for a cool $6,800 — TOPC TXA2 can take 4 SSDs and drives 4 8K monitors
item.description: TOPC's TXA2 combines AMD's Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495, 192GB RAM, four SSD slots, and quad-monitor support at substantial prices.

item.title: Elon Musk actually follows through on Grok AI adaptation of The Odyssey
item.description: Elon Musk promised an AI “Odyssey” to rival Christopher Nolan’s. The first Grok Imagine episode is out, and it's rough.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says a forgotten 1950s European alliance secretly secured Taiwan’s chip empire — decades later, an island hardly bigger than Maryland dominates 90% of the advanced chip market
item.description: Jensen Huang traces Taiwan’s semiconductor rise to foreign partnerships, industrial planning, opportunities in computer manufacturing, and decades of investment and engineering.

item.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
item.description: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

item.title: After parting ways with Xbox, I pray that Double Fine is working on more games like Psychonauts 2 — one of the best platformers since Super Mario Odyssey
item.description: I'm finally jumping into Psychonauts 2 — one of the best platformers since Super Mario Odyssey

item.title: Google is quietly linking your phone number to other Android accounts
item.description: Adding a new SIM to your phone links it to all Google accounts, and any new Google accounts you add all inherit your phone number.
